metas.name: Breaking Bad
metas.description: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer turns to manufacturing and selling methamphetamine with a former student to secure his family's future.

metas.name: Game of Thrones
metas.description: Nine noble families vie for control of Westeros and the Iron Throne, while an ancient threat beyond The Wall begins to stir.

metas.name: The Legend of Hanuman
metas.description: When the power-hungry Ravan tore through the world to unleash evil, in his way stood a humble vaanar awoken to his divinity to become an immortal legend.

metas.name: Dexter: Resurrection
metas.description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

metas.name: Panchayat
metas.description: A comedy-drama, which captures the journey of an engineering graduate Abhishek, who for lack of a better job option joins as secretary of a Panchayat office in a remote village of Uttar Pradesh.

metas.name: Sherlock
metas.description: In modern-day London, brilliant but eccentric detective Sherlock Holmes teams with war veteran Dr. John Watson to crack baffling crimes, outwit formidable foes, and aid Scotland Yard with razor-sharp deduction.

metas.name: India's Got Latent
metas.description: Samay Raina and the guest judges hilariously critique the untapped, undeniably entertaining "latent" talents of aspiring performers, testing their self-awareness with a unique scoring system.

metas.name: Dhindora
metas.description: It revolves around Bhuvan and his family's everyday lives, when an unexpected purchase leads to a series of events and depicts every common man's larger than life dreams.

metas.name: Ted Lasso
metas.description: American college football coach Ted Lasso is hired to manage AFC Richmond, a struggling English soccer club, and must win over skeptical players, staff, and fans.

metas.name: Dark
metas.description: A family saga with a supernatural twist, set in a German town where the disappearance of two young children exposes the relationships among four families.

metas.name: Twin Peaks
metas.description: An idiosyncratic FBI agent investigates the murder of a young woman in the even more idiosyncratic town of Twin Peaks.

metas.name: Heated Rivalry
metas.description: Two rival hockey stars at the top of their game face an unexpected challenge when they develop feelings for each other, complicating their careers and the sport's expectations.

metas.name: Severance
metas.description: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

metas.name: Stranger Things
metas.description: In 1980s Indiana, a group of young friends witness supernatural forces and secret government exploits. As they search for answers, the children unravel a series of extraordinary mysteries.

metas.name: Justified
metas.description: Enforcing his own brand of justice, U.S. Marshal Raylan Givens, a strong-willed, quiet law-man haunted by his past, returns to his native town to see that justice is served to those in need.

metas.name: Dexter
metas.description: He's smart. He's lovable. He's Dexter Morgan, America's favorite serial killer, who spends his days solving crimes and his nights committing them.

metas.name: Broken But Beautiful
metas.description: Veer and Sameera, strangers with opposite personalities, are left heartbroken after losing loves they thought would last forever. When fate gives the damaged souls a second chance, a beautiful love story unfolds.

metas.name: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
metas.description: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

metas.name: Mirzapur
metas.description: A shocking incident at a wedding procession ignites a series of events entangling the lives of two families in the lawless city of Mirzapur.

metas.name: Spartacus
metas.description: The life of Spartacus, the gladiator who led a rebellion against the Romans.

metas.name: Slow Horses
metas.description: A dysfunctional team of MI5 agents navigate the espionage world's smoke and mirrors to defend the UK from sinister forces.

metas.name: Normal People
metas.description: A man and a woman embark on an on-again/off-again romance that starts at school and continues through college, testing their relationship as they explore different versions of themselves.

metas.name: Prison Break
metas.description: A structural engineer installs himself in a prison his company helped design, to save his falsely accused brother from a death sentence by breaking both of them out from the inside.

metas.name: MobLand
metas.description: Power is up for grabs as two warring crime families clash in a battle that threatens to topple empires. In the crossfire stands Harry Da Souza, a street-smart 'fixer' who knows too well where loyalties lie when opposing forces col...

metas.name: The Mentalist
metas.description: Famous "psychic" Patrick Jane outs himself as a fake, and using his heightened observational skills and impeccable knowledge of the human psyche, he works with the police so he can find "Red John", the madman who killed his family.

metas.name: Mussolini: Son of the Century
metas.description: Benito Mussolini's early career from his founding of the Fasci Italiani in 1919 up to the assassination of socialist politician Giacomo Matteotti in 1924 and his speech in Parliament on 3 January 1925.

metas.name: Black Clover
metas.description: Asta and Yuno were abandoned together at the same church and have been inseparable since. As children, they promised that they would compete against each other to see who would become the next Emperor Magus.

metas.name: Money Heist
metas.description: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

metas.name: Shrinking
metas.description: A grieving therapist starts to tell his clients exactly what he thinks. Ignoring his training and ethics, he finds himself making huge changes to people's lives - including his own.

metas.name: House of the Dragon
metas.description: An internal succession war within House Targaryen at the height of its power, 172 years before the birth of Daenerys Targaryen.

metas.name: Lessons in Chemistry
metas.description: In the 1950s, Elizabeth Zott's dream of being a scientist is challenged by a society that says women belong in the domestic sphere; she accepts a job on a TV cooking show and sets out to teach a nation of housewives way more than ...

metas.name: Bad Sisters
metas.description: The Garvey sisters are bound together by their parents' deaths and a promise to always protect one another.

metas.name: The Tudors
metas.description: Epic series reveals the scandalous life of a young king whose affairs and obsession with producing a male heir changed marriage, the church, and the world.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: Silo
metas.description: Men and women live in a giant silo underground with several regulations which they believe are in place to protect them from the toxic and ruined world on the surface.

metas.name: Widow's Bay
metas.description: A skeptical mayor leads the superstitious residents of a cursed New England island.

metas.name: Man vs. Wild
metas.description: Bear Grylls travels the world in search of challenges to his survival skills.

metas.name: The Morning Show
metas.description: An inside look at the lives of the people who help America wake up in the morning, exploring the unique challenges faced by the team.

metas.name: Married... with Children
metas.description: Al is the quintessential working class dad. Peggy, his wife, always wants more from him. With their children, they go through the highs and lows of ordinary life.

metas.name: For All Mankind
metas.description: In an alternative version of 1969, the Soviet Union beats the United States to the Moon, and the space race continues on for decades with still grander challenges and goals.

metas.name: Black Bird
metas.description: Jimmy Keene is sentenced to 10 years in a minimum security prison but he cuts a deal with the FBI to befriend a suspected serial killer. Keene has to elicit a confession from Larry Hall to find the bodies of as many as eighteen wo...

metas.name: Mayor of Kingstown
metas.description: The McLusky family are power brokers tackling themes of systemic racism, corruption and inequality in Kingstown, Michigan, where the business of incarceration is the only thriving industry.

metas.name: Counterpart
metas.description: A cog in a bureaucratic agency discovers his agency is guarding a crossing to a parallel dimension.

metas.name: The Messiah
metas.description: It tells the story of Enric, who is heavily impacted by a viral video of a Christian pop band made up of five sisters.

metas.name: Titoo
metas.description: Titoo is an animated kids' comedy show that follows the daily escapades of eight-year-old boy Titoo. Though, he is a good-hearted, intelligent kid who loves to help everyone, but inadvertently manages to brew even more trouble.

metas.name: Defendant
metas.description: A prosecutor has lost his memory and discovers that he is convicted on death row. He is now left with no option but to find the truth behind his condition and prove his innocence.

metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: Vision is faced with many challenges while trying to regain his memory and humanity.

metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: Masters of Sex
metas.description: Drama about the pioneers of the science of human sexuality whose research touched off the sexual revolution.

metas.name: Preacher
metas.description: After a supernatural event at his church, a preacher enlists the help of a vampire and his ex to find God.
